name: @you-agent-factory/factory-graph
description: Lossless Factory graph source contracts shared by semantic graph renderers.

scripts.prepare:dependencies: bun run --cwd ../client build && bun run --cwd ../components build && bun run --cwd ../factory-replay build
scripts.test: bun run prepare:dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run prepare:dependencies && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:package-boundary && bun run check:pack
